subject: general
question: Anil spends 40% of his income on rent and 40% of the remaining income on medicines. If he saves ₹7,200 every month, then his monthly income is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume **Total Income** is 100 units.

**Rent** = 40% of 100 = 40 units | **Remaining** = 100 − 40 = 60 units.

**Medicines** = 40% of 60 = 24 units.

**Net Savings** = 60 − 24 = 36 units.

Since 36 units = ₹7,200 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹200.

**Total Income** = 100 × 200 = ₹20,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Spending on Rent** = 40%

**Spending on Medicines** = 40% of **remaining income**

**Total Savings** = ₹7,200

**Formula Used:**

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72225b85bb24681ed636813a29a66cc95126c8260ffba64305eb8b58d6c244c.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the **monthly income** of **Anil** be x.

⇒ x × (1 − 40/100) × (1 − 40/100) = 7200

⇒ x × (60/100) × (60/100) = 7200

⇒ x × (3/5) × (3/5) = 7200

⇒ x × (9/25) = 7200

⇒ x = (7200 × 25) ÷ 9

⇒ x = 800 × 25

⇒ x = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Decrease

When a value is reduced by a% and then the remainder is reduced by b%, the effective reduction is given by the formula: [a + b − (a × b)/100]%.

Remaining Balance Method

For multiple successive deductions, if the final value is S, then Initial Income = S ÷ [(1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100) × ...].

Income-Expenditure Relation

Income = Total Expenditure + Savings. In percentage terms, Total % = Σ(% Spent on each category) + % Saved.
